player_prompt.intro: Barka da zuwa Lights Out! Kana da wani {size}x{size} grid na fitilu. Your manufa shi ne ya juya ALL fitilu KASHE (wakilci da '.') A lokacin da ka danna wani haske, shi toggles kanta da kuma ta makwabta (sama / kasa / hagu / dama). Type [row col] to danna wani haske (0-indexed, don haka inganci kewayon ne 0-{max_index}). Kana da har zuwa {max_turns} motsa warware wuyar warwarewa. Legend: 'O' = haske ON, '.' = haske KASHE

board.current_state: Yanayin grid na yanzu (Move {moves_made}, {moves_left} sauran motsi, {completion}% cikakke): {grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aiki dole ne a cikin tsari [row col] inda jere da shafi sune lambobi daga 0 zuwa {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Taya murna! Kun warware wuyar warwarewa a cikin motsawar {moves_used}!
outcome.loss: Wasan ya ƙare! Kun yi amfani da duk {max_turns} motsawa ba tare da warware wuyar warwarewa ba. Kammala na ƙarshe: {completion}% Yanayin ƙarshe: {grid}
